_comment: Country-to-counterpart measures (annual). For each measure, `counterparts` maps an entity id to the source's code for it; WLD is the total over all counterparts (used for shares). `precedence` (fdi) picks, for each country and counterpart, the first basis with any data, so one series never mixes sources: host = reported by the receiving economy, investor = reported by the investing economy. Group values sum members (as of each year) when members with data hold >= 95% of the group's population.

measures.name: Public external debt owed to
measures.description: Public and publicly guaranteed external debt outstanding, by creditor country (official, commercial-bank and other lenders), current US dollars. Low- and middle-income countries only.

measures.name: Direct investment from
measures.description: Inward direct investment position (stock, net), by immediate investing economy, current US dollars.
